Here are three currently purchasable approaches in India:

Option	Approx. cost	Practical switching difficulty
SAVAA SEPT 7-piece layering set	₹4,999	Low — multiple fragrances, designed specifically for mixing/layering.
Sol de Janeiro Bom Dia Jet Set	₹3,280	Low–medium — coordinated body-care scent, but you’d add a separate perfume for a full perfume + body routine.
Nykaa Wanderlust matching collection	~₹1,500–₹3,000 depending on products	Medium — easy to build a matching shower gel + lotion + mist/EDP, but requires selecting individual products.

SAVAA is the most purpose-built option: its seven-piece set is explicitly designed to create multiple layering combinations. SAVAA SEPT 7-piece layering set

Nykaa Wanderlust has coordinated collections such as Swiss Vanilla, French Lavender and Dreaming of Paris across EDPs, body lotions, shower gels and mists.

Key trade-off: SAVAA minimizes experimentation; Nykaa gives more control but takes more effort to assemble and switch routines.

For a 5-person team in Gurugram, these are three practical options currently available:

Provider	Indicative cost	5-person monthly cost	Switching difficulty
WeWork BlueOne Square	₹20,000/desk	₹1.0L	Low
Awfis Woco One	₹22,000/desk	₹1.1L	Low–medium
Smartworks RK Four Square	Quote required	TBD	Medium

WeWork's ₹20,000 rate is a current promotional private-office rate; Awfis lists ₹22,000/month and says the displayed amount includes first-month billing + security deposit. 
WeWork India
+1

Switching practicality: all three are plug-and-play, so physical relocation is straightforward. The friction is mainly deposit lock-in, notice period, GST/invoicing, seat allocation, IT/network setup and moving monitors/storage.

For a 5-person startup, I'd get written quotes from all three with 12-month vs monthly pricing, deposit, notice period and meeting-room credits before deciding.
